description_en: Modifies the callback settings of an interactive messaging application
description_zh: 修改互动消息应用回调信息
name: ModifyLiveMessageAppCallback

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application whose callback settings you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for events such as user logon, logoff, joining a group, and leaving a group. If you leave this parameter empty, callbacks are disabled. The callback URL must start with http:// or https:// and cannot contain a private IP address or a port number
parameters.help_zh: 用户登录、登出、加入、离开群组等事件回调地址。若为空则不开启回调。事件回调地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号
parameters.name: event_callback_url

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AppId.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application
AppId.description_zh: 修改回调的互动消息应用ID

AppSign.description_en: The signature of the interactive messaging application. It is required by the interactive messaging SDK
AppSign.description_zh: 互动消息应用签名，互动消息服务SDK需要该信息

EventCallbackNeedAuthentication.description_en: Indicates whether authentication is required for event callbacks. Default value: true
EventCallbackNeedAuthentication.description_zh: 事件回调是否需要鉴权。默认为true

EventCallbackUrl.description_en: The callback URL for events such as user logon, logoff, joining a group, and leaving a group. This parameter is not returned if it has an empty value
EventCallbackUrl.description_zh: 用户登录、登出、加入、离开群组等事件回调地址。若为空则不返回
